results.title: Add a friend, the whole way
results.checks: As someone new to the app, the real way: Sign in with Faithnet (the Home's window; its demo person Seed Reader; Allow), open Friends, type 'alice', Send request; the small window that opens asks 'Add alice.me as a friend?' — Yes, add them — and closes by itself; the reader says Alice was asked. Then Cancel the request the same way ('Remove … as a friend?' — Yes, remove them). Screenshots of every step with E2E_SHOTS
results.note: 'Add alice as a friend?' → Yes; the window closed itself in 15s and the reader said Alice was asked. 'Remove alice.me as a friend?' → Yes; closed in 9s; the request is gone
